Package org.jdesktop.lg3d.displayserver.desktop2d

Class NotificationModel

java.lang.Object
org.jdesktop.lg3d.displayserver.desktop2d.NotificationModel
public final class NotificationModel extends Object
The desktop's notification log: the ordered set of notifications raised so far (newest first), an unread count for the taskbar tray's badge, and change listeners so the tray and the toast overlay stay in step.

The log is capped: adding past capacity evicts the oldest, so a long-running desktop cannot grow it without bound. The clock and the id sequence are internal but the clock is injectable, so tests get deterministic timestamps. Pure state and listeners (no Swing, no Java 3D); the long "now" is supplied by the caller's clock rather than read here, keeping every method unit-testable headless.
